𝐎𝐧𝐞 𝐋𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐫 𝐌𝐨𝐬𝐭 𝐏𝐘𝐐𝐬 𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐛𝐲 𝗔𝗯𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗮𝘃 𝗦𝗮𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗸

1. लौंग पौधे की पुष्प कली से प्राप्त होती है।
Clove is obtained from the flower bud of the clove plant.

2. भारत में राज्यसभा के प्रथम सभापति डॉ. एस. राधाकृष्णन थे।
The first Chairman of the Rajya Sabha in India was Dr. S. Radhakrishnan.

3. नंद वंश के शासक महापद्यनंद ने ‘एकराट’, ‘सर्वक्षत्रान्तक’ और ‘द्वितीय परशुराम’ की उपाधियाँ धारण की थीं।
Mahapadma Nanda of the Nanda dynasty assumed the titles of ‘Ekarat’, ‘Sarvakshetrantak’, and ‘Dwitīya Parashuram’.

4. विजयनगर में दासों के क्रय-विक्रय को ‘बेसवग’ कहा जाता था।
The buying and selling of slaves in Vijayanagara were called ‘Besvag’.

5. ‘राष्ट्रीय चिकित्सा विज्ञान अकादमी’ नई दिल्ली में स्थित है।
The National Academy of Medical Sciences is located in New Delhi.

6. 1993 ईस्वी में आए भूकंप से लातूर तबाह हो गया था, जो महाराष्ट्र राज्य में स्थित है।
Latur, located in Maharashtra, was devastated by the earthquake in 1993.

7. औरंगजेब के शासन काल में भारतीय शास्त्रीय संगीत पर सर्वाधिक पुस्तकें प्रकाशित की गईं।
During the reign of Aurangzeb, the maximum number of books on Indian classical music were published.

8. भारत के सकल घरेलू उत्पाद में सर्वाधिक योगदान तृतीयक क्षेत्र का है।
The tertiary sector contributes the most to India’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP).

9. ‘अटाला मस्जिद’ का निर्माण इब्राहिम शर्की ने करवाया था।
The Atala Mosque was built by Ibrahim Sharqi.

10. ‘राष्ट्रीय यूनानी संस्थान’ बंगलुरू में स्थित है।
The National Institute of Unani Medicine is located in Bengaluru.

📌 ACQUISITION OF CITIZENSHIP.

#Citizenship

🔺️ BY DESCENT

🔸️ A person born outside India on or after January 26, 1950 but before December 10, 1992 is a citizen of India by descent, if his father was a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ A person born outside India on or after December 10, 1992 is considered as a citizen of India if either of his parents is a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ December 3, 2004 onwards, a person born outside India shall not be a citizen of India by descent, unless his birth is registered at an Indian consulate within one year of the date of birth or with the permission of the 
Central Government, after the expiry of the said period.

कड़ी मेहनत, प्रतिभा को भी हरा देती है।
(Multiple Choice Q & A) 
  --------------------------------------
1 .Who was conferred with the prestigious Lokmanya Tilak National Award 2026 in Pune?
पुणे में प्रतिष्ठित लोकमान्य तिलक राष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार 2026 से किसे सम्मानित किया गया?
Answer: - Ajit Doval (National Security Advisor) / अजीत डोभाल (राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सलाहकार)

2 . Who assumed charge as the 54th Director General of the Geological Survey of India (GSI), becoming the first woman to head the organisation in its 176-year history?
भारतीय भूवैज्ञानिक सर्वेक्षण (GSI) के 54वें महानिदेशक के रूप में किसने कार्यभार संभाला, जो इसके 176 वर्ष के इतिहास में संगठन का नेतृत्व करने वाली पहली महिला बनी हैं?
Answer: -  Varsha Ashok Aglawe / वर्षा अशोक अगलावे

3 . Who became the first Indian decathlete to win a medal at the Commonwealth Games by clinching a bronze in Glasgow 2026?
ग्लासगो 2026 में कांस्य पदक जीतकर राष्ट्रमंडल खेलों में पदक जीतने वाले पहले भारतीय डेकाथलीट कौन बने?
Answer: - Tejaswin Shankar / तेजस्विन शंकर

4 . Which Indian para-athlete won the gold medal in the men's F57 shot put category at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026?
ग्लासगो राष्ट्रमंडल खेल 2026 में पुरुषों की F57 गोला फेंक (shot put) श्रेणी में किस भारतीय पैरा-एथलीट ने स्वर्ण पदक जीता?
Answer: - Soman Rana / सोमन राणा

5 . Who is the author of the recently released book titled 'The EV Evolution: Then, Now and Next of Electric Vehicles'?
हाल ही में जारी पुस्तक 'The EV Evolution: Then, Now and Next of Electric Vehicles' के लेखक कौन हैं?
Answer: -Anil Sasi / अनिल सासी

6 . In which country is the Paks nuclear power plant, which has recently been in the news, located?
हाल ही चर्चा में रहा पाक्स  परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्र किस देश में स्थित है?
Answer: - Hungary / हंगरी

7 .Which famous mountaineer passed away recently?
 हाल ही में किस प्रसिद्ध पर्वतारोही का निधन हुआ ?
Answer: - Nirmal Purja / निर्मल पुरजा

8 . Which medal did Neeraj Chopra win in the men's javelin throw event at the 2026 Glasgow Commonwealth Games?
ग्लासगो राष्ट्रमंडल खेल 2026 की पुरुष भाला फेंक स्पर्धा में नीरज चोपड़ा ने कौन सा पदक जीता ?
Answer: - silver medal / रजत पदक

9 .Who assumed charge as the new Deputy Chief of Naval Staff of India?
भारत के नए नौसेना उप प्रमुख के रूप में किसने कार्यभार संभाला है?
Answer: - Vice Admiral AN Pramod / वाइस एडमिरल एएन प्रमोद

10 .Which renowned Indian violinist was recently conferred with Sri Lanka's highest state honour for his contribution to classical music?
हाल ही में किस प्रसिद्ध भारतीय वायलिन वादक को शास्त्रीय संगीत में उनके योगदान के लिए श्रीलंका के सर्वोच्च राजकीय सम्मान से सम्मानित किया गया है?
Answer: - L. Subramaniam / एल. सुब्रमण्यम

11 Which Indian boxer won the gold medal in the women's 54kg category at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026?
ग्लासगो राष्ट्रमंडल खेल 2026 में महिलाओं के 54 किग्रा वर्ग में किस भारतीय मुक्केबाज ने स्वर्ण पदक जीता?
Answer: -  Preeti Pawar / प्रीति पवार

12 .Who won the gold medal for India in the men's 60kg boxing category at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026?
ग्लासगो राष्ट्रमंडल खेल 2026 में पुरुषों के 60 किग्रा मुक्केबाजी वर्ग में भारत के लिए स्वर्ण पदक किसने जीता?
Answer: -  Sachin Siwach / सचिन सिवाच

#Citizenship

The Citizenship Act of 1955 prescribes five ways of acquiring citizenship, viz, birth, descent, registration, naturalisation and incorporation of territory: 

🔺️ BY BIRTH

🔸️ A person born in India on or after January 26, 1950 but before July 1, 1987 is a citizen of India by birth irrespective of the nationality of his  parents. 

🔸️ A person born in India on or after July 1, 1987 is considered as a citizen of India only if either of his parents is a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ Further, those born in India on or after December 3, 2004 are considered citizens of India only if both of their parents are citizens of  India or one of whose parents is a citizen of India and the other is not an  illegal migrant at the time of their birth.
 
🔸️ The children of foreign diplomats posted in India and enemy aliens  cannot acquire Indian citizenship by birth.

📌 INTEGRATION OF PRINCELY STATE.

#Unionanditsterritories

🔸️ At the time of independence, India comprised two categories of political units, namely, the British provinces (under the direct rule of British government) and the princely states (under the rule of native princes but subject to the paramountcy of the British Crown). 

🔸️ The Indian Independence Act (1947) created two independent and separate dominions of India and Pakistan and gave three options to the princely states which are :-

• joining India, joining Pakistan or remaining independent. 

🔸️ Of the 552 princely states situated within the geographical boundaries of India, 549 joined India and the remaining 3 (Hyderabad, Junagarh and Kashmir) refused to join India.

🔸️ However, in course of time, they were also integrated with India–Hyderabad by means of police action, Junagarh by means of referendum and Kashmir by the Instrument of Accession.

शिक्षा मंत्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान ने दिया इस्तीफा

📌 FAZL ALI COMMISSION.

#Unionanditsterritories

🔸️ The creation of Andhra state intensified the demand from other  regions for creation of states on linguistic basis. 

🔸️ This forced the Government of India to appoint (in December, 1953) a three- member States Reorganisation Commission under the chairmanship of Fazl Ali to re-examine the whole question. 

🔸️ Its other two members were K.M. Panikkar and H.N. Kunzru. It submitted its report in September 1955 and broadly accepted language as the basis of reorganisation of states. But, it rejected  the theory of ‘one language-one state’. 

🔸️ Its view was that the unity of India should be regarded as the primary consideration in any redrawing of the country’s political units.
